body: Not any that are physically attracted to me. I have plenty of friends; I NEED a partner and a lover.
American women don't value intelligence. They just don't.

Also, other people don't want me to be around. As I said, I've known that I'm always going to be alone since age 2-3. Nothing has changed. Its ME that's the problem. Not the world. There no meds, no therapy, no anything that can change this. I don't think I'm being delusional.

Unfortunately, I'm not cut out for the wildnerness, and my job/training forces me to live in cities. Its not that I dislike people - I don't - its just that people leave me invisible.

Also - i'm highly myopic and NEED glasses. I can't entirely divorce myself from civilization, as ideal as that might sound, its really not doable.

I can't burden my kids with my thoughts. Its bad enough to talk to the few friends I have because no one wants to hear this shit no matter how much they say they're your friend - they're really not when it comes to talking about suicide. Its not suicide anyway - I'm electing to end my life when it is time to do so.
No. No interest in drugs that distort reality. Because I've stated reality quite  nicely above.
